title: Safe refactor: split a giant report function

steps.request: lib/report.js has grown into one giant function that nobody wants to touch. Refactor it into small, well-named functions (you can split it into modules under lib/report/ if that helps). This is a pure refactor: buildReport's output must stay byte-for-byte identical for every input, and `import { buildReport } from './lib/report.js'` must keep working.

acceptance: buildReport output identical to the original for many generated datasets
Import path lib/report.js still exports buildReport
No function longer than 40 lines in lib/report.js or lib/report/
